messages:
amy.ae: Heads up — CFO of ProspectCorp asked whether our air-gapped POC can be maintained without a full-time ops team. they want cost estimate for 6/12/24 month upgrade cadence.

ravi.se: short answer: yes, but tradeoffs. we can do immutable bundles + delta patching, or periodic full-image upgrades. deltas reduce bandwidth but increase signing/patch tooling complexity.

jenny.sec: for their compliance posture they require signed SBOMs, HSM-backed signing, and offline cert rotation plan. also they want encryption-at-rest with customer KMS.

amy.ae: pricing question — do we charge per-download or a fixed maintenance seat for offline support? they hinted at 3 remote sites with limited bandwidth.

ravi.se: proposal options: 1) quarterly deltas (sideloadable USB) + 6mo full bundle, 2) 6mo full bundles only (simpler), 3) on-prem agent with patch orchestration (higher TCO). I'll add estimated engineering effort.

jenny.sec: note: HSM integration adds +SLA around key custody. if they insist customer-managed HSM, we need runbook + longer onboarding (legal + network review).

amy.ae: can you outline expected on-call/support delta? sales needs numbers for the quote.

ravi.se: rough: delta-only approach -> 2 support seats (during release windows) + monthly health-checks. full-bundle -> 1 seat per 6mo for validation + emergency on-call. agent-orchestration -> 3 seats and 24/7 on-call depending on SLA.

tom.eng: technical constraints — our quantized bundles are ~2.1GB; delta patches average ~50-200MB depending on model changes. USB transfer feasible but needs checksum verification and signed manifest. show command example: ```sh
# validate bundle
sha256sum rwd-bundle.tar.gz && rwd-verify --manifest manifest.sig
```

jenny.sec: add requirement: offline audit log export and tamper-evident stamping. also need a rotation cadence for root CA in sealed environments — recommend 12-18 months with manual approval.

amy.ae: client asks if we can offer 90-day security patch SLA for critical fixes in offline mode. realistic?

ravi.se: with our current packaging flow: 90-day critical patch is tight for air-gapped unless we pre-stage hotfix bundles. ops complexity goes up, and cost increases by ~20-30% (patch readiness, expedited signing, logistics).

amy.ae: i'll present three commercial options: basic (6mo bundles), managed (quarterly deltas + 90-day critical promise), and premium (agent + orchestration + expedited patches). include per-site uplift for bandwidth-limited sites.

jenny.sec: last ask: include a short runbook snippet in the SOW showing step-by-step offline upgrade to satisfy their security team. keeps procurement happy.

ravi.se: i'll draft the runbook and the delta packaging checklist. aim to share in 48h.

deploy-bot: Release plan created: rwd-airgap-poc-v1 -> tasks assigned to ravi.se, tom.eng. ETA 2023-11-07. :white_check_mark:

amy.ae: perfect. thanks team — i'll sync with ProspectCorp and come back with which commercial tier they prefer. :pray:
